card.name: Words before a time period like year or day
card.fires_on: Small words such as per, once, each, a, every right after a quantity, where a time unit like year, day or daily comes next. Also seen after 'maximum' before '24-hour'.

modes.label: Rate per time unit
modes.description: A linking word after an amount or dose, followed by year or day.
modes.example: One five-foot tower can produce more than 200 heads of lettuce<< per>> year.

modes.label: Dose frequency
modes.description: The word once after a dose amount, before a day.
modes.example: rifampin 600 mg<< once>> a day, C max and AUC

modes.label: Other time-framing spots
modes.description: Words that open a time span or schedule, such as a blank after maximum or the start of regimen.

card.writes: It pushes toward Chinese time-period words like half-year, year-end and annual.
card.plain: It fires on the little word just before a time period, as in 'per year' or 'once a day'.
